title: Project Charter
description: Draft a one-page project charter: objectives, scope statement, key stakeholders, high-level milestones and success criteria.

title: Work Breakdown Structure
description: As a team, decompose the project scope into a WBS down to work-package level. Include a WBS dictionary for the top 10 work packages.

title: Schedule & Gantt Chart
description: Build the project schedule with dependencies, durations and resources. Identify the critical path and submit the Gantt chart export.

title: Risk Register
description: Identify at least 12 risks, score probability and impact, and propose a response strategy and owner for each.

title: Final Project Presentation
description: 15-minute team presentation covering scope, schedule, budget, risks and lessons learned. Slides due before class.
